Content: The diagnostic system shall monitor ECU nodes over the CAN bus for Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs).
When any safety-critical fault is confirmed
column3: the diagnostic system shall log the event timestamp to non-volatile memory.

Content: If the vehicle battery voltage drops below 9.0V
column3: then the system shall suspend all diagnostic reporting until voltage is restored.

Content: When the ECM detects a misfire rate above 2% over a 200-revolution window on any cylinder
column3: the ECM shall enter catalyst-protection mode.

Content: While in catalyst-protection mode
column3: the ECM shall cut fuel to the affected cylinder.

Content: While in catalyst-protection mode
column3: the ECM shall limit overall engine torque to 60% of normal output.

Content: If three consecutive clean drive cycles pass without the misfire recurring
column3: then the ECM shall exit catalyst-protection mode and restore full torque.

Content: When catalyst efficiency drops below the predefined threshold
column3: the ECM shall set the P0420 fault code.

Content: When the P0420 fault is set
column3: the ECM shall turn on the check-engine light.

Content: When the P0420 fault is set
column3: the ECM shall set the emissions-readiness status to "not ready".

Content: If the P0420 fault is set
column3: then the ECM shall not limit engine performance.

Content: If one complete drive cycle finishes without the P0420 fault reappearing
column3: then the ECM shall clear the "not ready" emissions status.

Content: When a lean fuel condition is detected
column3: the ECM shall increase fuel trim up to a maximum of 25% additional fuel.

Content: If the lean condition persists beyond the 25% fuel trim compensation limit
column3: then the ECM shall confirm the P0171 fault.

Content: When the P0171 fault is confirmed
column3: the ECM shall turn on the check-engine light.

Content: When the P0171 fault is confirmed
column3: the ECM shall capture and store the fuel pressure value at the moment of the fault.

Content: When an internal transmission problem occurs
column3: the TCM shall store a specific sub-code representing the root cause.

Content: When the TCM confirms an internal transmission problem
column3: the TCM shall force the transmission into 3rd gear within 0.5 seconds.

Content: When the P0700 fault is confirmed
column3: the TCM shall request the check-engine light to turn on.

Content: When the P0700 fault is confirmed
column3: the TCM shall broadcast the underlying sub-code on the diagnostic bus.

Content: When the ABS module confirms an internal fault
column3: the ABS module shall disable ABS

Content: When the ABS module disables the control systems
column3: the ABS module shall enable base (non-assisted) braking.

Content: When the ABS module confirms an internal fault
column3: the ABS module shall notify the body control module to illuminate the ABS

Content: If a module on the network stops receiving engine-control data
column3: then the module shall retain the last valid values for 2 seconds.

Content: If engine-control data communication is not restored within 2 seconds
column3: then the module shall switch to pre-defined safe default values.

Content: While engine-control data is unavailable
column3: the instrument cluster shall display dashes instead of numbers for engine data fields.

Content: When communication with the ABS module is lost
column3: the system shall turn on the stability-control and traction-control availability indicator.

Content: Where an alternate speed measurement source is available
column3: the system shall automatically switch to that source upon loss of ABS communication.

Content: When communication with the ABS module is lost
column3: the system shall log the timestamp of the event for root-cause analysis.

Content: If the resistance in the driver airbag deployment circuit falls outside the range of 2.0 to 3.0 ohms
column3: then the SRS module shall disable deployment for that airbag circuit.

Content: When the B0010 fault is confirmed
column3: the SRS module shall turn on the airbag warning light.

Content: When the B0010 fault is confirmed
column3: the SRS module shall permanently store the fault in non-volatile memory.

Content: If the vehicle is restarted
column3: then the SRS module shall not automatically clear the B0010 fault.

Content: Where a diagnostic tool is connected and the underlying physical issue has been repaired
column3: the SRS module shall allow clearing of the B0010 fault.

Content: When the BCM detects an abnormal supply voltage
column3: the BCM shall shut off non-essential electrical features within one second.

Content: When the BCM shuts off non-essential electrical features
column3: the BCM shall not request the check-engine light to turn on.

Content: When the BCM shuts off non-essential electrical features
column3: the system shall alert the driver using an audible chime.

Content: When an abnormal supply voltage is detected
column3: the BCM shall record the voltage behavior for the 5 seconds leading up to the fault.

Content: If overall vehicle voltage stays below 11.5 volts for more than 3 seconds
column3: then the ECM shall reduce power to non-critical accessories.

Content: If a U0100 or U0121 fault occurs within 5 seconds of a P0562 fault
column3: then the system shall flag the communication faults as related to the low voltage event.
